method: Read-only audit. Repo config inspection + Supabase read-only queries + 19 live /leagues metadata calls + 30 targeted fixture-level probe calls (lineups/events/players) for 6 non-configured candidate leagues + 8 follow-up calls to confirm a K League 1 anomaly. No collection at scale, no model changes, no league validated by extrapolation from Premier League.

premier_league_reference.evidence: Score+Player validated via lib/player-lab (V1/V2, OOS_DEV 2023-24 + OOS_FINAL 2024-25, commits dc39690e/a4231495). Market: Supabase odds_snapshots shows real T72/T24/T6 phases (4 fixtures, source=pipeline) but zero CLOSE snapshot and zero forward_odds_timeline rows for premier as of 2026-09-05 - no forward-vs-outcome validation performed yet.

candidate_leagues_resolved.name: Superliga
candidate_leagues_resolved.resolved_via: GET /leagues?search=Superliga, filtered by country=Denmark (6 same-named leagues exist worldwide)

supabase_snapshot.note_no_fixtures_or_player_markets_table: No dedicated 'fixtures' or 'player_markets' relational table exists. Player market data lives inline as JSONB in match_premium_data.player_markets. No historical bulk store - this project's Supabase is an OPERATIONAL live-tracking store, not a Score/Player Lab dataset warehouse (that role is filled locally by data/gate-b1 + data/player-lab/raw, currently Premier-League-only).

predictions_archive.interpretation: Summer/civil-calendar rotation captured while the 11 European big-5-style launch leagues were in their off-season. Not representative of current pipeline league set. Zero rows for premier/laliga/seriea/bundesliga/ligue1/eredivisie/primeira/jleague/ldc/el/ecl at any date.

local_historical_backfill.premier_league: 1520 fixtures fully backfilled (lineups+players+events), seasons 2021-2025, data/gate-b1 + data/player-lab/raw. Fully validated through Score Lab (M2/rho) and Player Lab (V1/V2, OOS_DEV+OOS_FINAL).
local_historical_backfill.all_other_leagues: ZERO local historical backfill exists for any of the other 18 leagues examined (12 already-configured + 6 candidates). This is the single most important finding: CONFIGURED (13) is not HAS_DATA (1).

api_football_coverage_current_season_202: See league-coverage-report.json (2026-09-03, real /leagues calls) for the 13 configured leagues' current-season analysisTier (12/13 FULL_ANALYSIS, el/ecl/primeira/jleague STANDARD_ANALYSIS due to missing injuries or statistics_players for el).
historical_seasons_coverage_flags_2021_2: Re-verified live for all 19 leagues examined (13 configured + 6 candidates): events/lineups/statistics_fixtures/statistics_players/standings = true for every league and every season 2021-2025 (with the noted exception of el 2021-2024 missing statistics_players/injuries, ecl/primeira/jleague missing injuries in several years). odds coverage flag = false for ALL leagues for seasons 2021-2025 (only true for the current 2026-27 season) - historical bulk odds via this endpoint is not indicated as available for any league, including Premier League.

real_fixture_level_probes.method: 1 mid-season 2023 FT fixture per candidate league: lineups + events + fixtures/players, plus a current-season (2026) fixture count check.

premier_league_baseline_for_comparison.sample: 50 real 2023-24 fixtures from local cache, 1992 player rows

championship.verdict: comparable to PL baseline, not a red flag

kleague1.verdict: CONFIRMED GAP: fixtures/players returns ZERO rows for 2023 and 2024 seasons specifically (verified across 5 sampled fixtures: 3 in 2023, 1 in 2024, cross-checked against populated 2021/2022/2025/2026), despite lineups and events being present and the /leagues coverage flag claiming statistics_players=true for those years. This is exactly the kind of gap a boolean-only check would miss.

real_fixture_level_probes.interpretation: The shots/SOT sparsity initially looked like a weakness of the 5 populated candidates but is statistically indistinguishable from Premier League's own established baseline (which the entire V1/V2 Player Scorer pipeline already handles via null!=0 Bayesian shrinkage) - NOT a blocker. The K League 1 2023-2024 player-stats hole is a genuine, real, single-league finding that would break the exact WARMUP/TRAIN/OOS_DEV/OOS_FINAL season split used for Premier League and require a redesigned split for that league specifically.
real_fixture_level_probes.sample_size_caveat: Each of the 5 non-K-League probes is a SINGLE fixture (~36-40 player rows). This is sufficient to confirm the coverage flags are not entirely fictitious, but NOT sufficient to certify league-wide data quality - a larger multi-fixture sample is recommended before any backfill commitment, per the audit's explicit instruction not to validate by extrapolation.
